verdicts.reason: Both share the same defects. The header band is crushed, so the sun logo is a dot and the SOLSTICE wordmark falls out of it onto the cream at an unreadable size. The 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow drops below the body copy as illegible micro-text, which breaks the reading order. The orange divider is left stranded above the headline. A big dead gap sits between the copy and the CTA, while the legal text is nearly as large as the body copy. A is slightly worse: its headline runs almost into the canvas edges ('Small-Batch' has no side margin), while B keeps a modest gutter.
